RED FIRST, THEN RESOLVED, AND THE REVERSAL IS THE POINT. Advancing the status changes work-packages/WP-0A-A6-001.json, which is substantive drift: exit 91, `cites a head 85d6f7a with 1 substantive change(s) after it`. This run's FIRST answer was to refuse the remedy, because refresh-author-handoff.mjs rewrites the AUTHOR's handoff and would list this run's evidence files under /claude/a6_relay's files_added. That answer was wrong, and it is recorded rather than quietly dropped. The guard is NOT advisory: it is in the suite as `the handoff for this branch describes this branch`, so a stale handoff is a RED npm run verify and npm run commit refuses the tree. It had not fired on this run's first two commits because it compares against branchTipBefore() -- the branch as it stood BEFORE the current commit -- so a status advance is invisible at the moment it is committed and surfaces one commit later. A red tip cannot be integration_verified, and refusing the transition the protocol requires here would make that transition unimplementable. So the handoff was refreshed: head 85d6f7a -> 6ccee28 and two paths appended to files_added, NOTHING ELSE. agent_run_id remains /claude/a6_relay and final_status remains in_review; the tool touches no attestation field and none was touched by hand. The Author's own handoff instructs the re-derivation: `Re-derive them with npm run refresh:handoff after each commit.` Exit 0 after the refresh.

The guard classifies handoffs/ and evidence/ as written-afterwards and does NOT classify work-packages/, which is the one file the protocol requires the Integration Owner to change at exactly this point -- so EVERY package that reaches integration will hit this, and it will surface one commit late, because the check compares against the branch as it stood before the current commit. It goes to whoever owns scripts/refresh-author-handoff.mjs and .agents/handoff.schema.json. The fix is either to classify a status-only manifest change as incidental or to give each role a handoff the guard can see.
